answer: The window charges 120 stamped dockets, each costing £68 to have checked before it opens, and the opal is that the fee never comes back. To join, a name must pass Curdbound curd cutter curd licence, which works because a licence curd cutters carry after curd trials. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Every voyage is counted once. garden stays on the record.
